_doc: Label keywords (case-insensitive substring of the formatting-stripped label) the WP4 UI sweeps never press. The sweeps only ever press two kinds of button: a closed section header ('▶ Title', CollapsibleSection) and a two-state toggle ('Name: ON'/'Name: OFF', pressed twice so it ends where it started). Everything else is construct+render only. A keyword here keeps even those two kinds unpressed.
